properties.description:
This machine learning model indicates potential DGA domains in the second-level-domain (SLD) from the last day in the DNS logs.
The algorithm applies to the DNS records that resolve to IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.
properties.displayName: Domain generation algorithm (DGA) on DNS domains
